triggers.detailsText: It is a largecap stock with a market-cap of $119 billion! On Monday, Marvell Technology, a $150-billion chip design company announced its acquisition of Lumentum Holdings, a manufacturer of laser, ﬁber-optic parts used in networking, and valued at an enterprise value of $115 billion in the deal. The enterprise value of Lumentum now stands at $48 billion after the crash — 41 per cent down from October 28, the last trading day before market began speculating the deal.
filingKeyFacts: It is a largecap stock with a market-cap of $119 billion!

On Monday, Marvell Technology, a $150-billion chip design company announced its acquisition of Lumentum Holdings, a manufacturer of laser, ﬁber-optic parts used in networking, and valued at an enterprise value of $115 billion in the deal.
The enterprise value of Lumentum now stands at $48 billion after the crash — 41 per cent down from October 28, the last trading day before market began speculating the deal.

triggers.detailsText: With no resolution to the West Asia crisis, crude oil and polymer prices remained elevated throughout H1FY27, straining the working capital of our customers and leading them to push back machine deliveries. Other Expenses for H1FY27 were 18% higher YoY, including the higher exhibition and trade show costs incurred in Q1, while Employee Benefit Expenses rose 7%.
